newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY-SPRINGBOKS AIM FOR VICTORY SWEEP IN FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-SPRINGBOKS AIM FOR VICTORY SWEEP IN FRANCE.

text.p: The touring Springboks have made it plain that they want to win all five of their matches in France and their first opportunity comes against the French Barbarians on Saturday.
"We face two tests and three other matches and our goal is simply to win them all," warned South African coach Andre Markgraaff.

The Springboks, who arrived in France direct from Argentina this week, certainly looked impressive against the Pumas, winning both tests as well as their other two tour matches with a combination of powerful, open and fluent rugby.
But, with the first test in Bordeaux on November 30, the French Barbarians will be looking to land a psychological blow and repeat their achievement in 1992 when they beat the Springboks in Lille.

Some members of that team, such as Agen hooker Marc Dal Maso and world-class centre Philippe Sella, now playing for English first division club Saracens, will play for the Barbarians again on Saturday.

Sella was also a member of the French side which narrowly lost to South Africa in the rainswept World Cup semifinal in Durban last year and he is joined in the Barbarian ranks by two other veterans of that day in scrumhalf Fabien Galthie and Marc Cecillon who will pack down at lock.
The inclusion of All Black flanker Josh Kronfeld will also lift the home side.
"The team looks good with such gifted players as Kronfeld and Sella," said French manager Jo Maso, who is also looking after the Barbarians.
"The challenge will be to play exciting rugby. Against a powerful side like the Springboks, that's never easy."

Markgraaff has essentially chosen his "B" team which is led by the Natal flanker Wayne Fyvie and includes lock Hannes Strydom and props Garry Pagel and Marius Hurter who all played in the 1995 World Cup.

Barbarians - 15-Sebastien Viars; 14-Franck Corrihons, 13-Guillaume Bouic, 12-Philippe Sella, 11-David Venditti; 10-Laurent Mazas, 9-Fabien Galthie; 8-Thierry Labrousse, 7-Marc Lievremont (captain), 6-Josh Kronfeld, 5- Grant Ross, 4-Marc Cecillon, 3-Maurizio Reggiardo, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Pierre Triep-Capdevielle

South Africa - 15-Russell Bennett; 14-Andre Snyman, 13-Dick Muir, 12-Jeremy Thomson, 11-Joe Gillingham; 10-Franco Smith, 9-Kevin Putt; 8-Johan Erasmus, 7-Wayne Fyvie (capt), 6-Theo Oosthuizen 5-Fritz van Heerden, 4-Hannes Strydom, 3-Marius Hurter, 2-Henry Tromp, 1-Garry Pagel.
